embeddings.text: Teacher Information: Sarah Chen is 32 years old and teaches Mathematics. They are responsible for class 3A. Their email is sarah.chen@school.edu and office hours are Monday and Wednesday 3-4pm. Notable characteristics: Known for using innovative technology in teaching; Organizes annual mathematics competitions.

Teacher Information: James Liu is 45 years old and teaches Science. They are responsible for class 3B. Their email is james.liu@school.edu and office hours are Tuesday and Thursday 3-4pm. Notable characteristics: Published several science textbooks; Leads the school's science club.

Teacher Information: Emily Wang is 38 years old and teaches Art. They are responsible for class 3C. Their email is emily.wang@school.edu and office hours are Friday 2-4pm. Notable characteristics: Professional painter; Organizes annual art exhibitions.

Class Information: 3A is located in the Third floor, East Wing. The class has Excellence in Mathematics and Technology and Known for winning regional math competitions. The head teacher is Ms. Chen (email: sarah.chen@school.edu). This class has 3 students.

Class Information: 3B is located in the Third floor, Central Wing. The class has Focus on Science and Research and Has a dedicated science laboratory. The head teacher is Mr. Liu (email: james.liu@school.edu). This class has 4 students.

Class Information: 3C is located in the Third floor, West Wing. The class has Strong Arts Program and Regular art exhibitions and performances. The head teacher is Mrs. Wang (email: emily.wang@school.edu). This class has 3 students.
